about: Questions for the component scope (app.rag.calibrate, ADR 0004). 'component' is what the photograph shows, as the detector would name it. 'expect' is the class whose manuals should answer. In the first eight the question is vague and the photograph says what it is about. In the last five the photograph shows one part and the problem is with another: the scope must not block the answer. No page is labelled; the measure is how many of the selected passages come from manuals of the expected class.
